subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures incorporate lessons learned from problematic data actions.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-1, SI-4 (System Monitoring)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.10.1 (Continual improvement), Clause 10.2 (Nonconformity and corrective action)
implementation_examples: Capture lessons learned from problematic data actions (incidents, complaints, DPIA findings, audit findings) and feed them into policy, process, and training updates
Close the loop by confirming that the policy/process/training change has been deployed and observed
assessment_objectives: Determine whether lessons learned are captured from incidents, complaints, audits, and DPIAs
Determine whether lessons are translated into policy/process/training updates
Determine whether updates are deployed and observed in practice
Determine whether lesson closure and evidence are tracked
